description: This file defines a React functional component named NotificationsPage that manages and displays friend request notifications, including fetching requests, subscribing to real-time events, and handling accept/decline actions.

methods.name: NotificationsPage
methods.description: React functional component that displays friend request notifications, manages real-time updates with subscriptions, and handles user interactions for accepting or declining requests.

methods.name: onAccept
methods.description: Handles the acceptance of a friend request, updates state, and refreshes user data.

methods.name: onDecline
methods.description: Handles declining of a friend request, updates state, and refreshes user data.
